description: cancel emits Cancelled before the release, so the audit log has the events in the wrong order (Cancelled before Moved and Released).
kern:
release escrow buyer amount
  audit.emit (Cancelled buyer clock.now)
  audit.emit (Cancelled buyer clock.now)
  release escrow buyer amount
ts:
release(c, escrow, buyer, amount);
  c.audit.emit({ kind: "Cancelled", buyer, at: c.now });

c.audit.emit({ kind: "Cancelled", buyer, at: c.now });
  release(c, escrow, buyer, amount);
